title: Constructed canonical factors with the proved coefficient tensor law
statement:
For an arbitrary preordered family of fields K_i, transition homomorphisms
ι_ij and embeddings e_i into a field Ω, suppose ι_jk ι_ij=ι_ik and
e_j ι_ij=e_i. Construct A_i, F_ij, c_ijk and p_ij by the canonical recipes of
[def-weil-frobenius-cohomology-comparison-factors]. Their natural-isomorphism tensor
cocycle holds by [lem-weil-frobenius-cohomology-coefficient-cocycle]. Bundle
these explicit fields with that proved law. The data are the given functors and
isomorphisms, independent of the proof field. Specialize this construction to
the finite coefficient fields and their specified embeddings into Ω, using the
recorded composition laws. Extend this coefficient record by the specified
rational cohomology functors H and rational scalar comparisons q. The result is
the canonical full factor record. Its scalar cocycle is the proof field of the
constructed scalar record; no rational cocycle is included or assumed in this
construction. No data are chosen from an existence theorem.

source.place: (1.1.1)(d), canonical iterated coefficient extension, and (1.1.14), ordinary and compact cohomology; explicit factor of Steps 1--2 of the parent proof.

proof.text: For each chain i ≤ j ≤ k apply the proved arbitrary-field tensor equation to ι_ij, ι_jk and ι_ik and the three embeddings. The system composition laws supply its four equalities. Use the natural-isomorphism form of this proved equation. Pass this proof and the explicitly constructed maps to the generic bundled record constructor. Its data fields are exactly the supplied maps.

Specialize the bundled construction to the specified small coefficient fields, coefficient inclusions and stage embeddings. Their stated composition equalities satisfy the constructor hypotheses. The scalar cocycle is obtained by taking the proof field.

Extend the coefficient record by the specified rationalStage and rationalComparison constructions. This builds the full FactorData record without requiring or postponing any data. Its H and q fields are the prescribed functors and isomorphisms, and its inherited scalar fields are the explicit coefficient construction.

proof_origin.place: G1: construct the literal coefficient maps together with their proved tensor law, then add the specified rational cohomology maps. No existence choice is used.

mathlib_searches.query: The natural scalar extension comparison of cohomology respects a tower of coefficient field embeddings

mathlib_searches.query: Compatible scalar extension natural isomorphisms yield invariance of conjugated functor maps at larger coefficient stages
mathlib_searches.results: ModuleCat.extendScalarsComp and extendScalars_assoc supply the ordinary module tensor comparison, not its specified scalar-and-size realization or operation mates.

mathlib_searches.results: stageBeta_coherence concerns pulled-back source/target operations. PointScalarNormalization is a different point-only statement. No result for these factor comparisons.

from.place: Canonical coefficient realization of the ordinary and compact cohomology complexes, coefficient enlargement; parent proof Steps 1 and 2.

lean.statement:
def realizationParts
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))) [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    [IsSeparated Y₀.hom]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    (c₀ : Compactification Y₀.hom) (compact : Bool)
    : FactorData
      (B := fun E : Index l Ω ↦
        @DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient l Ω E))
          _ _ (HasDerivedCategory.ofIsGrothendieckAbelian.{u} _))
      (bCategory := coefficientDerivedCategoryFamily.{u, v} l Ω)
      (D := @DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} Ω) _ _ (HasDerivedCategory.standard _))
      (stageSystem l Ω (D.geometricFiber Y₀).left)
